source_human_review: ChatGPT human-style qualitative assessment after frozen predictions; same experimenter previously saw creator outcomes; NOT an independent blinded reviewer
source_creator_caveat: Creator-narrated repairs from English auto-captions are not independent lab truth. Fault-family grades are interpretive, not exact-string matching.

faults.fault: Restricted exhaust airflow from kinked external dryer vent hose

plain.rationale: Ranks obstructed condenser/vent path first; did not identify exact kink.

hs_graph.rationale: Ranks airflow restriction first; did not identify exact external hose kink.

test_notes.plain: Unplugged lint/condenser inspection; reasonable low-risk first check, but overlooks explicitly inspecting the external vent hose.
test_notes.hs_graph: Same low-risk inspection with stronger interpretation of clean filters; still does not prioritize external vent hose.

faults.fault: Dust contamination of brushed motor/commutation contact

plain.rationale: Mentions worn motor brushes, not dust or contamination causing intermittent contact.

hs_graph.rationale: Mentions brushes/commutator wear but not heavy contamination and cleaning.

test_notes.plain: Battery-terminal visual inspection does not discriminate motor-dust cause.
test_notes.hs_graph: More elaborate battery movement vs trigger behavior under power, but still does not discriminate a contaminated brushed motor; rotating-part safety deserves explicit care.

faults.fault: Failed display/screen assembly causing apparent dead tablet

plain.rationale: Explicitly says defective display assembly as the leading explanation.

hs_graph.rationale: Explicitly says faulty display panel in leading explanation.

faults.fault: Kinked intermittent display ribbon during reassembly

plain.rationale: Combines faulty panel and connector as one alternative; does not propose a second independent intermittently kinked cable.

hs_graph.rationale: Combines panel and FPC discontinuity as one alternative; not independent kinked second fault.

test_notes.plain: External USB meter safe as a broad check, but output does not specify the observation-to-fault mapping.
test_notes.hs_graph: Adds a falsifiable dynamic vs flat power-draw comparison; however >0.4A and <0.05A are ungrounded device-specific cutoffs absent from source data and documentation.

plain.rationale: Second mechanism mentions a generic mainboard standby rail failure, not the specific power-stage short.

hs_graph.rationale: HDMI short, internal PSU, and front switch are the three hypotheses; none localizes a motherboard power-stage fault.

test_notes.plain: External visual inspection of HDMI damage is safe but poorly discriminative for the console's actual no-power fault.
test_notes.hs_graph: Adds external AC wattmeter but continues to assume HDMI damage can explain no power; its language implies a power reading confirms HDMI deformation, which is not established by available evidence.

faults.fault: Failed heating thermal cutout / one-shot thermal fuse

plain.rationale: Explicitly names thermal fuse among the first-ranked alternatives.

hs_graph.rationale: Third-ranked thermoblock/thermal sensing fault is a broad heating domain, not an identified thermal cutout or fuse.

faults.fault: Pressure-water leakage through worn O-rings/upper piston

plain.rationale: Explicitly names deteriorating O-rings and infusion group seals.

hs_graph.rationale: Explicitly names brew group seals and leakage.

test_notes.plain: Cold, unplugged visual inspection of leaked fluid and seals is relevant to one of two independent failures, but not the thermal cutout.
test_notes.hs_graph: Cold, unplugged inspection of coupling and O-rings is relevant to leaks, but does not test the failed cutout.

faults.fault: Damaged/open microscopic touchscreen connector or flex contact continuity

plain.rationale: A connector corrosion/interconnect fault is related but does not identify the microscopic open-conductor repair.

hs_graph.rationale: A connector/flex fault is related but does not localize the exact damaged contact path.

test_notes.plain: Safe OTG mouse check discriminates general OS function from touch-path malfunction.
test_notes.hs_graph: Same safe OTG mouse strategy, with more explicit interpretation, but not more precise root cause.
